changes: FM Synth answers ev_in_use (registration.c fm_in_use: an FM/1 track in the live Part or, swept a Part and a FLEX slot a UI tick, in any Part of any bank, working or saved, a legacy marker slot, GLIDE on, a pick through fm_admit_track). While it answers 0 its seven frame-path detours (runtime.json "rests") and its STATIC renderer and FLEX start entries (the row's "restingReferences") hold stock's bytes; po_rebase drops the clock's step measured across the rest.

sy_render ships a silent FM track's silence without the FM engine: with no voice of ours (GLIDE off), and with a released mono voice at silence (every DSP-visible write kept). Bit for bit the full path's output (test_silence.py against the FM_NO_SILENT build).

#1928's faster fm_frame (no per-track start loop in a frame without STARTs; 5,000 random cases match 0.1.4's). #1928's frame-prepare clock and LFO gate are dropped: on the owner's MKII they cost 1.3 to 1.6 frame points more than the rest alone whenever FM Synth was awake.
Needs a base with resting sites (0.7.10 or later).
